141:t_1:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch... Those Imperial bastards gave up on $$トウキョウ$$ with $$ゼロ$$ there, and now they're targeting $$カンサイ$$.」

141:t_1:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They are targeting $$厳島$$ Base here, the stronghold of $$カンサイ$$'s defense.」

141:t_1:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A large $$サイデリアル$$ force will converge here in four hours.」

141:t_1:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But $$厳島$$ is a source of hope for the people of $$新日本$$.」

141:t_1:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$藤堂鏡志朗$$'s 'Miracle of $$厳島$$'... This was the site of this country's only victory in its war with the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$...」

141:t_1:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We can't hand $$厳島$$ over to the invaders...!」

141:t_1:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The enemy may have chosen this target for precisely that psychological impact.」

141:t_1:13.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If so, the bastard's pretty damn smart. I still can't stand him.」

141:t_1:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then we'll have to fight them, ready to die. Even if we lose, we'll make them pay dearly and show them our will to fight.」

141:t_1:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That would preserve the Japanese people's pride. But from a broader perspective, the sacrifice would be needless.」

141:t_1:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I see your point. But stubbornness and pride are what's holding this country together now.」

141:t_1:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we lose those, we won't last long anyway.」

141:t_1:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even if we cannot hold out long, every moment we gain creates a chance to turn the situation around.」

141:t_1:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm not saying I want us to die fighting. ...But some things can never be regained once they're lost...」

141:t_1:20.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we lose our spiritual pillar now, we'll already be defeated at that point.」

141:t_1:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Let's leave it there, $$竜馬$$.」

141:t_1:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah... We've both said our piece. Now we'll have to let the commander decide.」

141:t_1:23.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Commander... Tell us what you think.」

141:t_2:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We've confirmed it in North America too. Some of the $$地球連邦軍$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ have surrendered to the Empire and formed a united front.」

141:t_2:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「So what we feared has come to pass...」

141:t_2:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To break this deadlock, we will cooperate with the regular military in an assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

141:t_2:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「So that's the $$新地球皇国$$'s most vital strategic stronghold, where the $$レイライン$$s from every continent converge...」

141:t_2:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we can take it, we should be able to even the odds on the North American front.」

141:t_2:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「I understand. I wish $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ success in battle.」

141:t_2:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We will win and bring you good news.」

141:t_2:12.en:
$$オットー$$
「Ideally, we should join the North American front as well, but...」

141:t_2:13.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Leaving $$新日本$$ now would be far too dangerous.」

141:t_2:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「Send for $$ゼロ$$. If we don't take countermeasures soon, things may get beyond repair.」

141:t_2:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Damn... If it's come to this, dealing with $$ダバラーン$$ and his brute force would have been better...」

141:t_2:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「...What do you mean the volunteer forces around the country are in turmoil...?!」

141:t_2:22.en:
$$スザク$$
「They're shaken because some of the $$地球連邦軍$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ cooperated with the $$新地球皇国$$ to attack $$新日本$$.」

141:t_2:23.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「This country has suffered foreign invasions before. Aliens are one thing, but an attack by fellow Earthlings would come as a major shock.」

141:t_2:24.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Wait a moment...! The battle at $$厳島$$ only just ended! How did the news spread so quickly?!」

141:t_2:25.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Calm down, $$ヒルデ$$. Naturally, we kept this top secret because of its psychological impact.」

141:t_2:26.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But the fact remains that the news has already reached ordinary civilians...」

141:t_2:28.en:
$$五飛$$
「We should assume someone deliberately leaked the information.」

141:t_2:31.en:
$$カレン$$
「Those bastards...! They knew the scars on the hearts of $$新日本$$'s people and planned this operation around them...!」

141:t_2:32.en:
$$五飛$$
「For them, using Earth's forces to capture $$厳島$$, $$新日本$$'s spiritual pillar, would have been ideal...」

141:t_2:33.en:
$$五飛$$
「But even if they couldn't take it, they probably thought shaking people's morale would be enough.」

141:t_2:34.en:
$$カレン$$
「I can't forgive them...! They even exploited our anger and grief for their operation...!」

141:t_2:36.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Their approach this time... It's clearly different from the Empire's previous tactics...」

141:t_2:37.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$新日本$$ has fought on until today thanks to its people's high morale...」

141:t_2:38.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So they planned an operation to undermine that... This is a fearsome enemy.」

141:t_2:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So you and the others were fighting in $$新日本$$ too, $$竜馬$$.」

141:t_2:40.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Given the situation, we took the quickest option and came to the nearest hot spot.」

141:t_2:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$大貫$$ was worried about you too.」

141:t_2:42.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll go back to $$陣代高校$$ when peace returns. Life there was plenty exciting too.」

141:t_2:43.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ドロシー#bigo$$, $$キリコ$$ and I joined the defense of $$新日本$$ at $$ゼロ$$'s invitation.」

141:t_2:45.en:
$n
「I had no idea you were fighting so close by.」

141:t_2:46.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is understandable. Communications between regions have been severed, and everyone has had their hands full with their immediate surroundings.」

141:t_2:47.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「In these circumstances, I am practically a soldier rather than a negotiator.」

141:t_2:48.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Are you all right with that, $$ロジャー$$?」

141:t_2:49.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Of course I am not satisfied with the situation. But an invasion is already beyond the stage where its right and wrong can be debated with words.」

141:t_2:50.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Therefore, by $$ロジャー$$'s law, I intend to confront them with the power of $$ビッグオー$$.」

141:t_2:51.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You can skip the excuses. Men can speak with their fists too. That's all you're saying, right?」

141:t_2:52.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「When I get caught up in your pace, I feel as though I might lose my pride in my profession.」

141:t_2:53.en:
$$五飛$$
「It would be good if everyone could come to terms with the situation both rationally and emotionally, as you have.」

141:t_2:54.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But that is difficult for many people, especially the people of $$新日本$$ with their wounded hearts.」

141:t_2:55.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Anxiety turns to distrust and breeds suspicion, gradually eating away at people's hearts...」

141:t_2:56.en:
$$カレン$$
「If this bitter mood keeps spreading through $$新日本$$...」

141:t_2:57.en:
$$スザク$$
「We won't be able to fight as a united force the way we have until now...」

141:t_2:58.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So that is the enemy's true objective.」

141:t_2:59.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it...! It's like a slow-acting poison...!」
